responsibility: This module contains GCC’s top-level driver and closely related support code that turns user command lines and installation configuration into concrete compiler, assembler, linker, and helper-tool executions. Its core is the reusable gcc driver implementation and main entry stub, which decode options, expand specs, choose languages and stages, manage temporary files, search prefixes, multilib and environment state, and coordinate subprocesses including linking via collect2 and LTO-aware tools. Surrounding files provide the driver’s path- and installation-resolution infrastructure (prefix rewriting, relocated tool/include lookup, built-in include defaults, and include-chain construction), language-independent predefined preprocessor macro setup, reproducible filename remapping for debug and macro paths, wrappers for external binutils tools with plugin injection such as gcc-ar, and the collect2/collect-utils family that wraps the linker to gather constructor, destructor, frame, and target-specific export information when final link behavior requires it. Together, these files define GCC’s command orchestration, tool discovery, include/preprocessor environment setup, and post-compilation linking support, distinguishing this module from front-end parsing, middle-end optimization, or target code-generation modules.
